entry_points.text: Write-only debug under one mutex: slash-led file path with index bounds plus optional order/offset, else pid with virtual bounds plus optional order/offset, pid one with no range meaning whole system; parse/copy failures invalid/fault else consumed length; shrinker count/scan expose depth and bounded reclaim.

Early wrapper forwards string to named setup via central registration; boot sizing uses node-exact placement when valid else rotating cursor; struct init prepares shared tails then parallel per-node conversion; size driver skips gigantic when CMA reserved but early inactive, honors per-node maxima else balanced alloc lowering maxima on shortfall.

exports.text: Two splitters share one divider: page-based uniform from start and folio-plus-offset non-uniform; minimum-order query gives anon zero, unmapped zero with later busy, else mapping minimum.
Shmem accounting recomputes from deltas plus occupancy, releasing surplus quota outside lock and reporting swap start; second helper forces recompute without deltas.

Folio walker under address-space lock brackets with begin/end, rejects out-of-range, descends clearing bad entries, rechecks huge levels under table lock for empty/table/leaf, records size/level snapshots, resolves ordinary pages with optional zero acceptance returning folio with leaf lock held; PUD helper forwards to shared discriminator.

PMD migration install captures state, negotiates exclusivity with busy restore, publishes swap entry and drops rmap/ref; remove rebuilds present entry and reattaches; anon rmap forwards huge accounting or warns.
Subpool create zeroes, inits lock, precharges minimum or frees null; node alloc dequeues under global lock else migration fallback; size-to-state scans for equal page size.

Isolate-or-dissolve succeeds for non-huge, isolated referenced, or dissolved free, fencing gigantic as no-memory; range walk replaces free non-gigantic folios; drain flushes deferred free work only when pending.

hazards.text: Split tolerates anon loss, truncation, eviction, size change, ref drift, cache replacement as busy/again; beyond-end tails may drop so retention uses head; deferred reads state before removal; scanners revalidate identity/zone/mapping after ref/lock and yield.

Gigantic lacks runtime dissolve/migrate support risking freelist corruption; migration must invalidate before anon share and restore on busy; replacement rechecks under lock treating unqueued zero-ref as transient retry after schedule.
Range replacement samples buddy order lockless so may skip but not corrupt; unvalidated boot pages freed to memblock with warning, totals reduced and maxima lowered on shortfall.

invariants.text: Split needs locked large folio, target below current, points inside, splittable verdict, file target above minimum plus reclaim probe; anon uses area write lock, file uses xarray cursor with interval read lock and size snapshot; then unmap, verified frozen divide, shmem release, remap, keep only retention locked, count orders.

Allocated/swapped counters under inode spinlock; surplus is allocated minus swapped minus occupancy with upward fix when swapped rises; positive surplus decremented under lock then quota/blocks released outside, with no-reserve reversal via page-rounded conversion.

System scan walks zones by pfn skipping offline/tail/small/hugetlb/unreclaimable/cross-zone/unstable then locked divide; pid scan masks to pages, skips DAX/special/IO/hugetlb, clamps file order, checks stability, picks ordered vs offset divide; file scan opens read-only stepping by miss or footprint with try-lock; underuse disabled at fanout-minus-one or poison else zero tally with early decisions.

Subpool null no-op else assert-positive decrement with final dispose; dup clears private linkage so child has no guarantee; clear releases owner via cgroup put then detaches; map destroy clears full range and asserts idle; fixup queries subpool warning on shortfall; region sums clamped overlaps under lock; lock release frees enclosing lock; flush conditional on optimizability.

Worker drains lockless list, detaches mapping, derives state from size, yields; bulk intake optimizes vmemmap then accounts/enqueues; pool tries nodes in order; single dissolve needs zero refs, rejects gigantic/empty, retries freed race, adjusts surplus, restores vmemmap with rollback; range steps by minimum order; migration rejects gigantic, accounts, unfreezes, marks temporary; replacement swaps under one lock, gigantic fenced no-memory.

Bulk vmemmap skips empty, splits per folio stopping on alloc failure after counting, flushes globally around optimize, on pressure flushes/frees/retries; disabled no-op; boot lists optimized first, unoptimized tails initialized after reserved prefix.

Early CMA only for gigantic when global-only and no arch allocator; reservation tries requested node then others unless exact else memblock; cross-zone queued unvalidated for reclaim else tail-queued validated; workers default quarter CPUs min one retrying only with progress; total CMA size or zero skipping gigantic with warning when inactive; migratetype per pageblock with alignment check.

locks.text: Folio lock on entry; anon write across unmap/divide; file interval read plus irq-off xarray around verify/divide with temporary memcg switch; shmem spinlock only arithmetic; deferred irq-safe list with RCU requeue; pid mmap read with try-lock; walk holds leaf lock on success; debug under interruptible mutex.

Global huge spinlock cache-aligned guards freelists/accounting/state/removal/enqueue with irq-saving bulk insert, never held across alloc/isolate/yield/release with revalidation; subpool count under own irq-saved lock; region under map spinlock.
Area write lock picks shareable lock else reservation semaphore, with matching unlock and try succeeding by default; combined unlock-free uses shared put path vs private unlock without free.

state_machines.text: Deferred queue count reports occupancy or empty; isolate moves live-referenced to private list clearing partial mark with stat fix; scan detaches, skips mlocked/used unless partial, tries locked divide, requeues on contention under RCU with affinity, stops only when nothing isolated and divided.
Migration preserves soft/dirty/userfault/young/dirty from present into swap entry and back, dirty marking folio, with device-private and prot-none transforms on restore.

Replacement retry discards spare for freed/referenced, yields and retries unqueued zero-ref, swaps genuinely free with spare; reservation reuse/needed/enforced with enforced as needed plus distinct completion; boot conversion runs vmemmap setup, folio setup, marker propagation, staging, bulk vmemmap, tail, migratetype, locked enqueue.

structs.text: Walk cursor holds level, leaf snapshot and pointer, held leaf lock, subpage for offset with null marking zero; base-page folio returned; caller pairs success with termination releasing lock/pin.

Registry has max count, default index, fixed array, boot node mask and per-node lists; cmdline pairs string with setup callback; boot parse holds pending state, defaults, validity flags, thread count, buffer and table indexes; boot record has linkage, size-class pointer, CMA/zone/preopt flags; compound head records order, map/pin counts, tracking, deferred linkage.

Debug write max 255 bytes; bytes to pages rounds up then shifts; cmdline capacity twice max states plus one; owner bit0 unmapped bit1 mask union; reservation modes needs/commit/end/add/delete; change reuse 0 needed 1 enforced 2.
